figures.description: Two-domain Gaussian linear regression, orthogonal 512-dimensional blocks, 128 examples per batch, 20 SGD steps. The two losses are normalized by their respective initial loss.
figures.transformation: The article SVGs use the two PDF frontier strokes and the fixed-mixture marker centers in the original 0 to 0.4 axis coordinates. Hovering the frontier reports approximate values linearly interpolated along the displayed vector curves. The linked originals are unmodified.

figures.recipe: The author confirmed that this run used the Nemotron data mixture recorded in the notes: 70B tokens each budgeted for web text, web Q&A and math, and 1B each for science and code.
figures.description: April pilot. The mmlu_fineweb and GSM8K trajectories are recorded at the same checkpoints up to the last point in the two weekly-report figures.
figures.transformation: Matched weekly figures to archived measurements of the same training run. Accuracy fractions converted to percentages and steps to thousands; original checkpoints, no smoothing.

figures.description: 124M, 2:1 knowledge-to-math mixture. Replot of slide2_per_domain_grad_norms.png in the June 11 training notes.
figures.transformation: For each observed domain and capture step, take the Euclidean norm of the 72 logged linear weight Frobenius norms. Use the training dump's step (SwanLab step minus one), displayed in thousands. The dark curves are centered rolling medians of each domain’s own observations (11 for knowledge, 7 for math), with truncated windows at the ends.

figures.transformation: Measured zero-shot accuracies in percent, with the same 20 checkpoints from 0 through 57,000 as the adjacent four-recipe comparison. No extrapolation or smoothing.
